name: peachy-duo-editorial
image_purpose: fashion campaign and social editorial visual

prompt.project_info: Create a playful high-resolution photorealistic editorial lifestyle image featuring two adult women and oversized peach props.
prompt.main_subject: Two adult women with original fictional identities, dark hair styled in neat buns, wearing white T-shirts with pink trim and peach-themed graphic treatment, matching peach-colored skirts, and white sneakers. The foreground woman lies on her stomach propped on her elbows with one hand on her cheek and a relaxed playful smile; the background woman stands with one hand on a giant peach and a cheerful expression.
prompt.composition_elements: Balanced focus on both women and oversized peach props, large peach in the center, peach slice above it, clean studio-style setup with white background and soft pink and light-blue accents. Optional peach graphic typography may be added in post.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright even studio lighting with soft shadows, high color visibility, clean fresh playful atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic editorial lifestyle photography, moderate depth of field keeping subjects and props sharp, high-resolution detail, natural anatomy, clean graphic composition.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Playful photorealistic editorial lifestyle photograph of two adult women with original fictional identities, dark hair in neat buns, wearing white T-shirts with pink trim and peach-themed graphics, matching peach-colored skirts, and white sneakers. One woman lies on her stomach propped on elbows with one hand resting on her cheek and a relaxed playful smile; the other stands behind with one hand on a giant peach and a cheerful confident expression. Oversized smooth vibrant peach props with a peach slice balanced above, predominantly white studio background with soft pink and light-blue accents, bright even studio lighting, soft shadows, balanced composition, colorful whimsical fashion editorial.
prompt.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, blurry, low resolution, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, cropped heads, CGI, 3D render, cartoon humans, text artifacts, watermark, logo, signature

assets.name: peachy-duo-editorial.jpg
assets.usage: Reference the adult duo, peach props, pink-and-blue studio palette, playful poses, and graphic T-shirt styling; treat shirt text as replaceable typography.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve duo hierarchy, poses, props, palette, and lighting consistency. Use original adult identities, keep outfits and products generic, replaceable, and logo-free, and add any peach typography only in post.

changes: Clarified both subjects as adults with fictional identities and made shirt typography replaceable while preserving the playful editorial concept.
